name: kixima-app
description: KIXIMA — e-market com pagamento garantido para o setor Oil & Gas

scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development node -r dotenv/config src/server.js dotenv_config_path=.env.development
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production node -r dotenv/config src/server.js dotenv_config_path=.env.production
scripts.prisma:migrate: cross-env NODE_ENV=development dotenv -e .env.development -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.seed: cross-env NODE_ENV=development node -r dotenv/config prisma/seed.js dotenv_config_path=.env.development
